messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert fired • severity=P0 • tenant=pegasus • symptom=reserved-pool throttle + elevated latency
pagerduty: Paging SRE-Jen (on-call)
SRE-Jen: ack — looking
SRE-Jen: what services impacted? any customer-visible 5xxs?
Eng-Ops-Carla: Grafana shows 99th latency for pegasus cluster spiking to 9s, error rate (502) up ~1.8% last 3m
Platform-Dawei: logs show repeated `KVCacheMiss` fallback to CPU path and queue depth climbing on workers in pool `pegasus-pool`
SRE-Alex: can we see reserved capacity utilization? `rpoolctl describe pegasus-pool`
Platform-Dawei: output:
```
pool: pegasus-pool
capacity: 16 GPUs
utilization: 98%
burst_tokens: 0
queue_length: 420
```
SRE-Jen: wow burst_tokens 0 — so we've exhausted burst. Are there any pinned long-running jobs?
Eng-Ops-Carla: recent sudden increase in long-context batch jobs from `ingest-service` — looks like a misconfigured batch window
Solutions-Juan: customer reported degraded chat experience in support ticket #3871 at 13:22 UTC, matches timeline
Customer-Support-Lina: Customer says "responses are timing out intermittently, seeing lots of 'service unavailable' in client logs"
SRE-Jen: mitigation plan:
- immediate: throttle non-critical ingest batch jobs from pegasus tenant by applying per-tenant QoS
- short term: enable fallback routing for read-only embed calls to hosted pool
- longer: increase reserved capacity or open burst tokens
SRE-Alex: I can apply a temporary routing rule — pushing change now: `routectl add rule --tenant pegasus --priority high --route hosted-fallback` (will take ~20s)
SRE-Jen: +1
pagerduty: SRE-Alex acknowledged the escalation
SRE-Alex: change applied — verifying
Platform-Dawei: seeing drop in queue length from 420 -> 120 in last 45s, p99 latency down to 1.6s
Eng-Ops-Carla: error rate falling to 0.3%
SRE-Jen: notify customer: "we have applied temporary routing and throttled non-critical batch jobs. Service should stabilize; we're monitoring."
Customer-Support-Lina: sent note to customer via ticket #3871 and Slack DM
Solutions-Juan: we should also open a Dedicated capacity request — suggest +4 GPUs or increase burst tokens; I'll draft SOW
SRE-Alex: can we grant emergency burst? `rpoolctl grant-burst pegasus-pool 10tokens` — need approval
SRE-Jen: I approve emergency 10 tokens now
Platform-Dawei: grant accepted — burst_tokens now 10, utilization 95%
SRE-Alex: confirming steady state: queue_length 45, p99 800ms
SRE-Jen: good. I'll stay on this for next handoff. @pagerduty escalate to infra if we see relapse in 30m
pagerduty: will escalate to infra if alert re-fires
incident-bot: note: created incident doc at https://redwood.internal/incidents/pegasus-1894056789
SRE-Jen: handing off to SRE-Alex at 14:05 UTC — continuing monitoring, will update incident doc
SRE-Alex: taking over for next 2 hours — will coordinate with Solutions-Juan on capacity plan
Customer-Support-Lina: customer acknowledged workaround and is on standby for follow-up
SRE-Jen: thanks team. closing pager for now but will keep the incident open until capacity plan is in place
pagerduty: SRE-Jen marked alert resolved
SRE-Alex: logging follow-ups in incident doc: root cause suspected: unexpected batch window + exhausted burst tokens. action items: 1) throttle policy, 2) capacity increase, 3) improve alerting on burst_tokens
Eng-Ops-Carla: +1 to improving alerting — current alert threshold too noisy
SRE-Alex: handoff complete — last check p99 760ms
SRE-Jen: signing off from on-call rotation. :wave:
